from typing import Any
import pytest
from tomlkit import parse, aot, table, dumps

def test_aot_captures_too_many_keys() -> None:
    doc = parse("a.b = 1\nc.d = 2\n")
    aot_instance = aot()
    t = table()
    t["x"] = 9
    aot_instance.append(t)
    doc["a"] = aot_instance
    assert "c.d" not in dumps(doc)
